# Snackpuncher: code map

<!-- generated by APP_MAKER/standard/app_map.py · 2026-11-08 · code 95614866891b · regenerate after every change -->

**Read this first, then open only the files it points to.** Line numbers are where definitions start; read
around them with an offset instead of whole files.

**What it is:** A VR punching quest for Meta Quest and WebXR headsets: fight a horde of cartoon fast food across ten lands. Every battle is a workout. Also plays on screens.
**Live:** https://snackpuncher.anvil.app · **Repo:** github.com/arkulinskis/snackpuncher · **Layout:** native Anvil Forms · **Deploy:** master
**Guide** (workflow, design rules, product knowledge): `snackpuncher/.claude/skills/snackpuncher/SKILL.md`

## How to change it

- **New page**: copy a similar `client_code/Pages/<Name>/` (form_template.html + __init__.py), register it in
  `client_code/router.py` (`PAGES`, `_form()`, and `NAV` for the menu). Address = `#name/arg`.
- **New list**: a RepeatingPanel in the page template + `client_code/Items/<Name>/`. **Dialog**: `client_code/Dialogs/<Name>/` opened with `alert(...)`.
- **New server function**: `@anvil.server.callable` in the matching `server_code` module (see *Server*), called with `state.call("name", ...)`.
- **New table/column**: `anvil.yaml` → `db_schema` (the user accepts Anvil's Schema Mismatch alert); update the server-test mock.
- **Drawing/media/canvas**: a JavaScript engine in `theme/assets/` wrapped by a Python module or a `Components/` form.
- **Styles**: `theme/assets/app.css` (colour tokens at the top; rules in APP_MAKER/design/README.md).
- **Check**: `python tools/check.py` → ALL CHECKS PASSED; UI: `python -I tools/ui_test.py` (Docker Desktop running).
- **Deploy**: commit as arkulinskis (+ Co-Authored-By) and `git push` (master unless apps.json says branch-first).
- **Footer** must keep: Submit feedback (Prepsto), Privacy & Terms, Contact developer (arkvital.com), Parent company (addanapp.com).
- **After any change**: `python -I C:/Users/arkvi/Documents/CLAUDE/APP_MAKER/standard/app_map.py snackpuncher` refreshes this map.

## Notes

<!-- NOTES: hand-written, kept when the map is regenerated -->
- **The battle is a JavaScript engine**: `theme/assets/sp-play.js` (moved unchanged from web/pages/play.html) registers
  `UI.page('play', ...)`; `Components/Battle` mounts it with `UI.mountScreen` on show and destroys it on hide
  (`Pages/Play.leave()` too). `Pages/Play` has no layout (full screen) and `waits = True`: the engine sets UI_READY.
- **Engine <-> Python**: `theme/assets/sp-kit.js` is the small `window.UI` the engines expect (api, apiQuiet, toast, go,
  page, busy, [data-go] clicks). `UI.api` goes through `window.SP_BRIDGE` = `sp._bridge` (anvil.server.call, JSON text).
  `SP.host.toast/go` are Python. `router.show()` sets `UI.me` (sp.sync_me) before every page.
- **One game cache**: `sp.game()` calls get_game once and hands it to the engine with `SP.prime` (added to sp.js), so a
  battle starts without a second call. Pages call `sp.game(force=True)`; battle calls (finish_battle, save_settings,
  mark_scene) clear the Python cache.
- `#play/<territory>` needs an account (router.show treats it as a user page); `#play/training` is open to guests.
- The map of Nourra (`Components/LandMap`) is an SVG drawing built in Python (one markup string), not a list.
- Old `.eyebrow` labels are gone (the battle panels show the land as `.pl-land` under the heading).
- Test robot: `window.SP_TEST = {autoplay: true, speed: 10}` then click `[data-flat]` (tools/ui/smoke.js does it).
- ArkMusic copy is now `theme/assets/ark-music.js`: point APP_MAKER/tools/music_sync.py at it after the merge.
<!-- /NOTES -->

## Tools

- `tools/assets.py`: Refresh the theme assets' cache-busting hashes in anvil.yaml (and icons.css).
- `tools/build_icons.py`: Write theme/assets/icons.css from the icon table in theme/assets/lh-kit.js (UI.ICONS).
- `tools/check.py`: Everything that must pass before pushing. Ends with ALL CHECKS PASSED.
- `tools/make_icons.py`: Make the PNG app icons from theme/assets/icon.svg (headless Chrome draws them).
- `tools/ui_test.py`: Run the app for real in the open-source Anvil App Server (Docker) and drive it with headless Chrome.
